rows.text: As you approach the ruins of a city-state, Aquila brings down heavy rain. You wander around in the downpour until finally finding shelter in a nearby cave.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As you watch droplets trickle down the protruding stone spikes, a wave of melancholy washes over you, until footsteps echo from deep within the cave. You're not alone.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Do you want to ask me about the Sealing Wax?" The old man reveals himself, his eyes burning like torches.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "If you want, you can come back to find me in these caves anytime. This is where I live." The old man tightens the cloth bag on his shoulder. "Perhaps soon, you'll understand the benefits of living in solitude."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
